taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航A330-300 B-18306傳退租　航跡紀錄列晚間自桃園離場
taiwan_aviation.summary: 據接獲消息，中華航空Airbus A330-300客機B-18306已退租，並安排於晚間離開桃園國際機場。截稿時，尚未取得華航就該架飛機退租及後續移交安排的正式公告；退租消息與公開航跡所能確認的範圍，仍須分開看待。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines A330-300 B-18306 Reportedly Returned off Lease; Tracker Lists Evening Taoyuan Departure
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Information received indicates that China Airlines Airbus A330-300 B-18306 has been returned off lease and was arranged to leave Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport in the evening. At publication, no formal airline announcement confirming this aircraft's lease return or handover arrangements had been obtained. The reported lease status should be distinguished from what public flight-tracking data establishes.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局宣佈國內線明日全數取消 國際航班仍可能調整
taiwan_aviation.summary: 交通部民用航空局表示，依國籍業者提供的最新動態，明日國內線全數取消；國際線也可能因颱風因素持續調整。民航局提醒旅客留意航班異動，並在出發前向航空公司確認航班動態。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan CAA Says All Domestic Flights Will Be Canceled Tomorrow
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said all domestic flights are scheduled to be canceled tomorrow, based on the latest information provided by local operators. International flights may also continue to be adjusted in response to the typhoon’s movement. The authority urged passengers to follow flight updates and confirm their flight status with their airline before departure.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航前四川航空3架A350是買的還是租的？年報與重大訊息揭露購機契約
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空於2026年陸續引進三架原由四川航空營運的Airbus A350-900，隨著B-18923在10月22日正式投入載客服務，三架航機究竟是由華航買下，或僅以租賃方式引進，也成為航空迷關注的問題。對照華航對外發布的重大訊息與2025年年報，這筆交易屬於購機，並非單純承接四川航空原有租約。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Did China Airlines Buy or Lease Its Three Ex-Sichuan A350s? Corporate Filings Point to a Purchase
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines introduced three Airbus A350-900 aircraft formerly operated by Sichuan Airlines during 2026. After B-18923 entered passenger service on October 22, questions arose over whether the trio had been purchased or leased. The airline's annual report and stock-exchange disclosures identify the transaction as an aircraft purchase rather than a continuation of Sichuan Airlines' former leases.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 松山機場如何迎接新世代廣體客機？長榮787-10進駐與華航A350的差異
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北松山機場（TSA）位處市中心，腹地與地面作業空間有限。近年新世代廣體客機逐漸投入臺灣航線，其中長榮航空已將波音787-10安排於松山往返東京羽田及上海虹橋（SHA），華航的Airbus A350-900則主要從桃園機場執飛。兩種代表性廣體機型為何有不同的機場配置，必須從停機位、翼展與地面作業條件觀察。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Songshan Airport's Widebody Challenge: EVA Air's 787-10 and China Airlines' A350
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA) is a city-center airport with constrained ground operating space. EVA Air now operates Boeing 787-10 flights from Songshan to Tokyo Haneda and Shanghai Hongqiao, while China Airlines predominantly deploys its Airbus A350-900 from Taoyuan. Understanding the different aircraft assignments involves stand compatibility, wingspan and operational requirements.

international_aviation.headline: BETA Technologies獲FAA特別適航證 可搭載客戶與合作夥伴飛行
international_aviation.summary: 聯邦航空總署（FAA）向 BETA Technologies 頒發市場調查用途的特別適航證，允許該公司以 ALIA VTOL A250 載運客戶與合作夥伴飛行。公司於2026年10月20日宣佈獲得授權，並在同一天稍早依新監管資格完成首趟飛行。
international_aviation.headline_en: BETA Technologies receives FAA certificate to fly customers on ALIA eVTOL
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) granted BETA Technologies a Special Airworthiness Certificate for market surveys, enabling the company to fly customers and partners on its ALIA VTOL A250 aircraft. BETA Technologies announced the authorization on October 20, 2026, after completing its first flight under the new regulatory status earlier that day.

international_aviation.headline: 瑞安航空宣佈冬季削減比利時20條航線並撤出6架飛機
international_aviation.summary: 瑞安航空表示，已於2026年10月20日宣佈，將在即將到來的2026年冬季大幅縮減比利時業務。公司計畫取消20條航線，整個冬季季節共涉及110萬個座位，並將6架飛機從目前設於比利時的基地撤出，重新部署至其他地區。
international_aviation.headline_en: Ryanair to cut 20 Belgian routes and remove six aircraft for Winter 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: Ryanair said on October 20, 2026, that it will significantly reduce its activity in Belgium during the forthcoming Winter 2026 season. The airline plans to cut 20 routes, accounting for 1.1 million seats across the season, and remove six aircraft from its current Belgian bases for redeployment elsewhere.

international_aviation.summary: 歐洲多國正考慮賦予關鍵基礎設施營運者更大權限，以因應無人機威脅，當中包括傳統上由國家機關執行的措施。各國仍須處理由誰有權應對無人機，以及無人機遭擊落後若造成人員受傷或財物損害，責任應如何歸屬等法律問題。
international_aviation.headline_en: European governments weigh expanded drone powers for infrastructure operators
international_aviation.summary_en: Several European countries are considering giving critical-infrastructure operators and contractors broader powers to counter drones, including measures traditionally reserved for state authorities. Governments still need to resolve who may respond to a drone threat and what liability could follow if a downed drone causes injury or property damage.

international_aviation.headline_en: IATA and OneVasco to integrate visa concierge service with Timatic
international_aviation.summary_en: IATA and OneVasco announced that OneVasco’s visa concierge service will be integrated into IATA’s Timatic Solutions.
